title: Edge
description: A derived, typed Faden projection between two entities. New participation projections identify Gesprächsfaden, Antragsfaden, Knüpffaden or Stimmfaden through faden_type; legacy projections may omit it. Dated, unverzwirnte Fäden expire exactly 168 hours after their server-owned creation timestamp; durable Webungsaktionen remain outside this projection. Fully undated legacy or non-authoritative preview projections explicitly carry a null lifecycle pair.

faden_type.description: Semantic participation type. conversation=Gesprächsfaden, proposal=Antragsfaden, knotting=Knüpffaden, vote=Stimmfaden. Omitted only for legacy/imported projections.

faden_subject_id.description: Stable semantic target of the participation, such as the proposal, conversation or node id. This can differ from the drawable center endpoint.

created_at.description: Server-owned start timestamp of the current derived projection lifecycle. Initial creation sets it; genuine repeated participation may reactivate the same typed Faden while durable action history remains in its source domain. Null is permitted only for a fully undated legacy or non-authoritative preview projection and must be paired with expires_at null.

expires_at.description: Server-owned active-projection boundary. For every dated, unverzwirnter Faden this is exactly 168 hours after created_at. When a persisted legacy record has created_at but no expiry, readers derive the same boundary without rewriting history. A fully undated projection carries null together with created_at null.
